title: Generalized stationary discs attached to degenerate submanifolds in $\mathbb{C}^N$
summary: We study the family of generalized stationary discs attached to a Levi degenerate submanifold M of codimension d in $\mathbb{C}^{n+d}$. We show, under suitable geometric assumptions on M, that this family forms a finite dimensional real submanifold of the Banach space of analytic discs.
